The '''Topside Dome''' was part of the [[Polis Massa Research Base]]. It was located directly above the ruins of [[Wiyentaah/Legends|Wiyentaah]] and contained the [[Turbolift/Legends|elevator]] to the dig site. The facility also provided [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and rest to the base's [[archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] and included an equipment store, artifact documentation facilities, a basic laboratory, and an analysis center.<ref name="SWCL" />
